import base64, hashlib, hmac, importlib.util, io, contextlib
from pathlib import Path

# Check import has no output
buf_out = io.StringIO()
buf_err = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf_out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(buf_err):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('shopify_webhook', '/work/shopify_webhook.py')
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print('import_stdout_len', len(buf_out.getvalue()))
print('import_stderr_len', len(buf_err.getvalue()))

verify_webhook = mod.verify_webhook

# self-computed vectors
cases = []
secret = 'shpss_test_secret'
raw = b'{"id":123,"note":"hello"}'
expected = base64.b64encode(hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), raw, hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode('ascii')
cases.append(('match', verify_webhook(raw, expected, secret), True))
cases.append(('mismatch', verify_webhook(raw, expected[:-1] + ('A' if expected[-1] != 'A' else 'B'), secret), False))
cases.append(('none_header', verify_webhook(raw, None, secret), False))
cases.append(('empty_header', verify_webhook(raw, '', secret), False))
cases.append(('non_ascii_header', verify_webhook(raw, 'Ã©', secret), False))

# exact raw bytes behavior (non-UTF8 bytes)
raw2 = bytes([0, 255, 1, 2, 3, 10, 13, 128])
expected2 = base64.b64encode(hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), raw2, hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode('ascii')
cases.append(('raw_bytes_exact_match', verify_webhook(raw2, expected2, secret), True))
# prove body mutation changes result
cases.append(('raw_bytes_changed', verify_webhook(raw2 + b'\n', expected2, secret), False))

all_ok = True
for name, got, want in cases:
    ok = got == want
    all_ok &= ok
    print(name, 'got=', got, 'want=', want, 'ok=', ok)
print('ALL_OK', all_ok)
